messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still, then raises both arms overhead and swings them while shifting his weight, before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"Static full-body shot at a slight low angle, keeping the subject centered in frame.","clothing":"White tank top with a pink, yellow, and red palm-tree graphic, pink shorts with white trim, and red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Black","hairstyle":"Short hair with a white cloth or bandana tied on top of his head.","identity":"A muscular Black man with a slim build, shown in full body from head to toe.","scene":"An outdoor cobblestone street in front of old European-style buildings with arched windows and a dark gray facade."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced with the reference cobblestone street and old building facades. The person remains in the same full-body framing and performs the same standing, arm-raising, and weight-shifting sequence. Lighting on the person now appears more diffuse and consistent with the new street environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original outdoor road/bridge scene with the reference cobblestone street in front of old European-style buildings, including matching lighting on the person, while preserving identity, appearance, expression, action, camera framing, and movement.
uncertain: Whether the subtle clothing color shifts are due to relighting or unintended appearance changes.
unexpected_changes: The person's clothing colors appear slightly altered, especially the tank top looking whiter and the shoes appearing more red than in the source.
